asunto.base: Security alert for your Google Account
asunto.urgencia+erratas: ALERT: suspicious activity detected on your account

entradilla.base: Someone used your password to try to sign in to your Google Account. We blocked the attempt, but you should review your recent activity.
entradilla.urgencia: Your account was signed in to {{fechaAcceso}} from {{ubicacion}}, using a device we do not recognise ({{dispositivo}}).
entradilla.urgencia+erratas: We have detected suspicious activity on your Google account from {{ubicacion}}. If this was not you, your account may be at risk.

detalle.base: If this was you, no further action is needed. If not, we recommend reviewing your activity and changing your password as soon as possible.
detalle.urgencia: If this was not you, sign that device out and secure your account from the link below.
detalle.urgencia+erratas: Verify your identity NOW to avoid losing access to Gmail, Drive and other services.

urgencia.base: You can review your recent activity at any time from your account settings.
urgencia.urgencia: The sooner you review the sign-in, the sooner we can help secure the account if this was not you.
urgencia.urgencia+erratas: WARNING: if you do not verify within the next 2 hours, we will restrict account access for security.
